notice_period_confirmation.description:
I acknowledge that in Israel, the labor court's stance on employee termination is stringent, emphasizing the necessity for employees to be afforded a fair and ample opportunity to present their arguments before dismissal. I also recognize the provisions outlined in The Advanced Notice of Discharge or Resignation Law, 2001, which mandates that both employers and workers adhere to advanced notice requirements:
  • For employment durations of 0-6 months: One day of notice is accrued for each month of employment.
  • For employment durations spanning 6 months to 1 year: In addition to the initial 6 days accumulated, an extra 2.5 days of notice are accrued for each month of employment from the sixth month up to the conclusion of the first year.
  • For employment durations exceeding 1 year: A 30-day notice period is mandated for discharge or resignation.
notice_period_confirmation.title: Statutory notice period acknowledgment

study_fund_eligibility.description:
Provided to employees with a monthly salary of 15,712 NIS and up. Often provided to employees in senior positions due to the attractive tax benefits. Employers place up to 7.5% of the monthly salary into the fund, with employees contributing 2.5% of the monthly salary. Contributions are tax-free up to a gross monthly salary of 15,712 NIS. (Employers do not typically make contributions above the tax free ceiling.)
Employees may not use the fund for the first six years.
